title: 第13章 万兽林第14章 最后一条路
content_zh:
外山弟子考核，在万兽林之中进行。
“宗门考核规矩很简单，丢进万兽林之中，只要你能活着走出去，就算你通过考核。不过本座要提前警告你，万兽林内甚至有三品妖兽！你要慎重！”
那位灰衣执事对林炎善意提醒。
他可不是在开玩笑，万兽林内是真的会死人的。
每年宗门考核，万兽林内都至少会陨落上百条性命，有的运气不好的气海四重，甚至五重都会遭劫。
哪怕是执事级人物都不愿轻易进入万兽林内。
“多谢前辈告知，但我心意已决。”
林炎抱拳。
他参加考核，成为外山弟子还有一线生机，如果不参加考核，林雄和尹海岂会让他活着离开？
现在的他，没有退路！
“行！”
灰衣执事不好再说什么，打开了闸门，将林炎投放了进去。
万兽林外，有着一块巨大的光幕，那是符文阵法，透过阵法能够看到万兽林内的场景。
“尹海执事，就这样让他参加考核？”此刻的林雄看着光幕中的林炎的身影，有点担心。
林五极有可能就是死在林炎的手中，也就是说林炎极有可能拥有能杀死气海四重的实力，这样的修为让他担忧。
要知道，修为在气海三重以上的弟子通过率是七成以上。
更别说能杀死气海四重的林炎了。
“想要从万兽林之中活着走出来，哪有那么容易？就算他是气海境九重，本座让他死，他也得死！”
尹海嘴角掀起一抹讥讽。
如果他没有把握，又岂会敢让林炎进万兽林？

平日里气海三重能通过，甚至气海二重都有五成的通过率，那是因为没有执事干预！
而现在，他不想让林炎通过考核，林炎就不可能通过！
吼！
万兽林之所以叫万兽林，就是因为这片森林中有着大量的妖兽，林炎刚一进入万兽林内，就听到了震天的咆哮声。
震耳欲聋！
“只要能在一炷香的时间内，活着走出万兽林，就算是通过了考核！”
林炎朝着万兽林的出口处方向掠去。
刚走出几十米远，林炎就遇到了一头妖兽。
那是一头二品妖兽，钢铁大猩猩！
身高八尺，人立而起就好像是一尊黑色的小铁塔般，獠牙无比狰狞。
此刻，这钢铁大猩猩正抱着一具尸体在啃，那尸体的脑袋已经烂掉了，钢铁大猩猩舌头就好像勺子一样，挖着血红色的脑浆吮吸，口中还不断发出舒爽的呻吟。
“这是……气海境四重的修士，看衣服应该是来参加宗门考核的！遭遇不测了！”
林炎双目微凝。
“吼！”
钢铁大猩猩也发现了林炎，它立刻放下了手中啃得只剩下半截的尸体，兴奋的朝着林炎跑了过来。
“这家伙有点倒霉啊，刚好传送进钢铁大猩猩的领地之中。”
外界灰衣执事看着光幕中的画面，很是诧异，深深地看了一眼旁边的尹海。
万兽林内，妖兽的分布也是有规律的，最强大的妖兽都是呆在万兽林最深处。
而正常来说，宗门考核，参赛的弟子会被先投放到外围区域。
林炎却被传送到了万兽林深处。

这种情况不多见。
“或许是他运气不好吧。”
content_en:
The assessment for outer mountain disciples is conducted in the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts.
"The rules of the sect's assessment are very simple. If you are thrown into the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts, as long as you can walk out alive, you will pass the assessment. However, I want to warn you in advance that there are even third-level monsters in the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts! You must be careful!"
The deacon in gray gave Lin Yan a kind reminder.
He was not kidding, people would really die in the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts.
Every year during the sect's assessment, at least hundreds of lives would be lost in the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts, and some unlucky ones at the fourth or even fifth level of the Qi Sea would be robbed.
Even the deacon-level figures are not willing to enter the Ten Thousand Beast Forest easily.
"Thank you for informing me, senior, but I have already made up my mind."
Lin Yan cupped his fists.
He took the assessment and had a chance to become an outsider disciple. If he didn't take the assessment, how would Lin Xiong and Yin Hai let him leave alive?
Now he has no way out!
"Okay!"
The deacon in gray didn't want to say anything else, so he opened the gate and threw Lin Yan in.
Outside the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts, there is a huge light curtain, which is a rune formation. Through the formation, the scene in the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts can be seen.
"Deacon Yin Hai, are you going to let him take part in the assessment like this?" At this moment, Lin Xiong looked at Lin Yan's figure in the light curtain, feeling a little worried.
It is very possible that Lin Wu died in the hands of Lin Yan, which means that Lin Yan is very likely to have the strength to kill the fourth level of Qi Sea. Such cultivation makes him worried.
You must know that the pass rate of disciples who are above the third level of Qi Sea is more than 70%.
Not to mention Lin Yan who can kill the fourth level Qi Sea.
"How can it be so easy to come out of the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts alive? Even if he is at the ninth level of the Qi Sea Realm, if I ask him to die, he will die!"
There was a hint of sarcasm at the corner of Yin Hai's mouth.
If he wasn't sure, how could he dare to let Lin Yan enter the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts?
On weekdays, the third level of Qi and Sea can pass, and even the second level of Qi and Sea has a 50% pass rate. That's because there is no deacon intervention!
But now, if he doesn't want Lin Yan to pass the assessment, it's impossible for Lin Yan to pass!
roar!
The reason why the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts is called the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts is because there are a large number of monsters in this forest. As soon as Lin Yan entered the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts, he heard a thunderous roar.
Deafening!
"As long as you can walk out of the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts alive within the time of burning an incense stick, you will have passed the test!"
Lin Yan swept towards the exit of the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts.
Just after walking a few dozen meters, Lin Yan encountered a monster.
That was a second-grade monster, a steel gorilla!
Standing eight feet tall, he stood like a small black iron tower, with extremely ferocious fangs.
At this moment, the steel gorilla was holding a corpse and chewing on it. The head of the corpse was rotten. The steel gorilla's tongue was like a spoon, digging into the blood-red brain and sucking it, and kept moaning in pleasure.
"This is...a monk at the fourth level of the Qi Sea Realm. Judging from his clothes, he must be here to take part in the sect's assessment! Something unexpected has happened!"
Lin Yan's eyes narrowed slightly.
"Roar!"
The steel gorilla also discovered Lin Yan. It immediately put down the half-chewed body and ran towards Lin Yan excitedly.
"This guy is a bit unlucky. He happened to teleport into the territory of the Iron Gorilla."
The deacon in gray outside looked at the scene in the light screen and was very surprised. He took a deep look at Yin Hai next to him.
In the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts, the distribution of monsters is also regular. The most powerful monsters stay in the deepest part of the Forest of Ten Thousand Beasts.
Normally, during the sect assessment, the participating disciples will be placed in the outer area first.
Lin Yan was teleported to the depths of the Ten Thousand Beasts Forest.
This situation is rare.
"Maybe he's just unlucky."
